title: Shehr bano kahi peet ke sar gor me mera bacha darega
body:
Shehr bano kahi peet ke sar gor me mera bacha darega
nanha lasha karu dafn kyu gor me mera bacha darega
<<DIVIDER>>
aah nanha kafan mai bataau apne haatho se usko pehnaau
qaak me isko kyu kar litaau gor me mera bacha darega
<<DIVIDER>>
chounk kar jab lahad me uthega koi is ko na apna dikhega
mere pehlu ko dhoonda karega gor me mera bacha darega
<<DIVIDER>>
sar hai mitti pe takiya kahaa'n hai, qaak toshak hai jhoola kaha'n hai
sab to sab maa ka pakhwa kaha'n hai gor me mera bacha darega
<<DIVIDER>>
Loriya'n qabr me koun dega koun sojaao pyaare kahega
doodh ye laal kiska piyega gor me mera bacha darega
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn kardo ye nanhe se jee ko soump deti hu rooh nabi ko
dam karo padhke naade ali ko gor me mera bacha darega
